appraisal_events.evidence: chaque soir... elle glissait dans ma bouche sa langue, comme un pain quotidien, comme un aliment nourrissant et ayant le caractère presque sacré de toute chair; the memory is set beside 'celle où mon père envoya maman dormir dans le petit lit à côté du mien.'
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator retrospectively sacralizes Albertine's nightly intimacy and cohabitation, placing it on the same plane as the cherished childhood memory of his mother's consoling presence, a narrator-endorsed movement of realized closeness and renewal.

status_effects.explanation: Albertine's nightly tenderness is framed as sacred, nourishing comfort, giving her a position of deep emotional significance for the narrator.
Albertine has given up her cruise plan and settled into a room near the narrator's own, establishing her as included within his household and daily life.

ambiguities: The passage sacralizes Albertine's presence while also noting 'les souffrances que nous avons endurées à cause d'elle,' a past-suffering undertone that qualifies but does not override the dominant local elevation.
